name: Lumina-Pets-Web-js
description: Responsive pet adoption shelter website built with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and Vite.

paragraphs: An interactive, multi-page web platform for an animal shelter designed to showcase pets available for adoption, share the shelter's mission, and connect potential adopters with their new furry friends. Built with semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JavaScript, and bundled with Vite.
features: Multi-Page Architecture: Structured navigation across Home (index.html), About Us (about.html), and Contact (contact.html) pages.
Dynamic Pet Gallery: Pet grid rendered dynamically via JavaScript DOM manipulation for seamless UI updating.
Adoption Request Form: Interactive contact form for prospective adopters to submit inquiries.
Responsive Layout: Mobile-first layout with clean typography and custom CSS styling.
Vite MPA Integration: Custom Rollup multi-entry configuration for fast development and optimized production builds.
